quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue by product (half-year report): drilling equipment RMB 3,619,519,580.82 versus RMB 1,691,527,756.26 a year earlier (+113.98%, gross margin 32.85%, +6.75 points); inspection/test equipment RMB 420,766,399.85 (RMB 209,020,748.87); routing equipment RMB 395,071,257.47 (RMB 141,174,295.12); exposure equipment RMB 298,714,671.91 (RMB 124,266,338.65); attach equipment RMB 69,829,377.46; lamination equipment RMB 18,944,475.28 (none a year earlier). Domestic sales RMB 4,344,445,823.78 (+106.74%, gross margin 35.14%); overseas sales RMB 640,474,989.43 (RMB 280,393,023.62). Net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 953,281,902.80 (+281.36%); operating cash outflow RMB 1,074,920,851.88, which the company attributes to larger purchasing and stocking for sharply higher orders on hand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (half-year report): its A-share IPO capacity project, the 'PCB special-purpose equipment production renovation and expansion project' (95.03% of committed funds invested), and its PCB equipment R&D center project both reached usable state on 06-30-2026 and were closed. Once fully ramped the production project is planned to give annual capacity of 3,780 units of PCB special-purpose equipment (drilling, test, attach and automation products) with annual output value of about RMB 252,000.00 ten-thousand, reaching 70% of normal output in its first year of production and full output in the second.
quarterly_data.figure: 3,780 units per year; output value about RMB 252,000.00 ten-thousand; 70% in year one

quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supply lock-in (half-year report): the company says it has set up long-term deep collaboration with core component suppliers to lock in key supply-chain capacity in advance. Prepayments rose to RMB 347,636,505.99 from RMB 112,822,916.35, of which a single unnamed supplier held RMB 295,285,714.34 (84.94% of prepayments, a share of prepayments, not of purchases); inventory rose to RMB 2,490,537,795.19 and accounts receivable to RMB 4,783,476,546.75.
quarterly_data.figure: prepayments RMB 347,636,505.99; largest supplier 84.94% of prepayments

quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Advanced packaging (half-year report): in joint development with several leading customers on next-generation substrates (3.2T NPO, CoWoP, CPO, CoWoS-L and EMIB-T driving mSAP high-layer HDI, large FC-BGA and glass-core substrates), it received formal orders for new laser equipment for BT and ABF drilling and high-precision grooving and for Core-layer mechanical drills with high-speed spindles; the company says revenue from these products may enter a fast lane as the substrate and embedded-packaging (ECP) markets expand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Han's CNC Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products and R&D (half-year report): its lamination system is in stable volume production of high-layer-count boards at customers and the company says orders may increase further; for optical-module substrate-like boards it is developing LDI with resolution below L/S 10/10μm and solder-mask openings down to 50μm, now in customer certification; it is exploring processing solutions for 3.2T optical modules and 448Gbps single-lane switch PCBs. R&D investment RMB 269,513,352.02 (+69.61%); R&D team 1,161 people as of 06-30-2026, 17.48% with a master's degree or higher.
